prompt:
Draw exactly ONE newly designed Small Seal glyph U+3D029.
The attached reference shows FOUR historical views of this SAME ONE Small Seal character ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC; some may be marked unavailable. Compare ALL AVAILABLE specimens equally to understand its identity. Create exactly ONE new independent, harmonious, contemporary monoline Gothic redraw informed by all witnesses, not a copy of one source and not a four-glyph grid. Preserve every essential branch, crossing, counter, attachment and separation. If variants disagree, choose one coherent attested whole structure, never combine incompatible components or substitute modern Chinese.
Output ONLY the ONE glyph in pure black on alpha transparency, large and centered within the central 70% of square canvas, generous margins, no background/text/labels/border/grid. Reconstruct the real intentional stroke courses as clean continuous centerlines, smooth rounded geometric curves and straight lines. Every stroke must have equal CONSTANT width about 4% of EM, with round end caps and joins, no brush taper, contrast, serifs, texture, blobs, doubled outlines, swelled intersections or decorative seal effects. Preserve all openings.
COMPLEX CHARACTER IDENTITY:
LEFT component is the three-diamond crown motif. THREE hollow diamond counters on stems, the middle taller. Two parallel horizontal bars under the diamonds, both coherently connected to the outer diamond stems, as in the attested THX whole arrangement. FIVE bottom descenders total: two outer diamond stems plus three inner descenders. Central inner descender attaches to bottom horizontal; two short inner side descenders are detached.
RIGHT TOP CRITICAL CONNECTION: draw TWO horizontal bars which BOTH JOIN the SAME upright LEFT VERTICAL. The vertical begins just ABOVE the upper bar, passes DOWN THROUGH the upper bar junction, and curves right to become the bottom bar. Thus this is a rotated comb with TWO right-facing teeth sharing one left upright, with the lower bar its curved bottom return. There must be NO GAP between either bar and that shared left vertical. Do NOT draw upper L plus a detached lower bar.
Directly below that connected two-bar motif is an upright oval/rounded rectangle with TWO internal horizontal divisions, making THREE stacked white counters.
Below the oval is a foundation stroke starting as a short detached vertical at its left, bending around into a broad horizontal underneath the oval, and two small outward-curving legs descend from it.
At the very bottom of the right component is the attested pair of longer crossing curved-diagonal strokes, one bending into a short right hook. Preserve all the lower details and all three diamond counters. No modern Chinese substitutions. Make the two connected upper bars immediately clear and distinct from the three-counter oval below.
